title: Block Out Version 729: Ivy and new levels
summary: The July 20, 2026 iOS release added the Mona Lisa workshop area, introduced Ivy-covered doors and shipped new levels with fixes and UX improvements.
changes: Added a workshop area behind the Mona Lisa.
Introduced Ivy, an obstacle cleared by removing blocks to reveal covered doors.
Included bug fixes and user-experience improvements.
